intent: Extract only the defined fields using exact source text. Preserve source formatting. Use null for absent or ambiguous scalar values; do not arbitrarily choose among multiple values. For repeated columns preserve each complete source row relation and exact supporting quotes.

fields.description: Final total price due for the receipt, preserving the printed amount and separators.
Cash tendered or cash paid on the receipt, when explicitly printed.
Change returned to the customer, when explicitly printed.
Receipt subtotal before tax or other separately stated final charges.
Separately printed tax amount for the receipt; not a percentage or service charge.
Name or description of each purchased menu item on its own receipt line.
Quantity purchased for each menu item. Keep its row aligned with the item name and line total.
Total price for each menu item line (CORD menu.price), not unit price (menu.unitprice). Keep it aligned with the same item's name and quantity.
